blocks.content: Given an array of integers, find the index of the first occurrence and the last occurrence of an element inside the array. For example,

array =  {2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 3}
element = 5
output 
first occurrence = 3
last occurrence = 4

array =  {4, 3, 5, 5, 5 ,5}
element = 5
output 
first occurrence = 2
last occurrence = 5

array =  {1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1}
element = 5
output 
first occurrence = 
last occurrence =
